$comment: Shared registry items. Components pull these in through registryDependencies.

items.name: kinetik-tokens
items.title: Kinetik Tokens
items.description: Colour, spacing, radius, type and shadow tokens with dark and light palettes, plus the optional KinetikProvider.

items.name: kinetik-motion
items.title: Kinetik Motion
items.description: The shared motion vocabulary: three springs, three durations, easings and the useReduceMotion hook.

items.name: kinetik-haptics
items.title: Kinetik Haptics
items.description: useHaptic: a small, meaningful haptic vocabulary that respects the provider switch.

items.name: kinetik-tilt
items.title: Kinetik Tilt
items.description: useTilt and TiltSensor: device tilt as shared values, read on the UI thread.

items.name: kinetik-clock
items.title: Kinetik Clock
items.description: useShaderClock: a pausable shader clock advanced on the UI thread, at 60 or 30 fps.

items.name: kinetik-shaders
items.title: Kinetik Shaders
items.description: Shared SkSL noise functions, lazily compiled runtime effects and colour uniforms.
